title: RenderSpec
description: Output of the Render Configuration Compiler for a single Shot: the final, engine-agnostic contract handed to a Video Engine Adapter (IVideoEngine.submit). This is the critical abstraction boundary - swapping Wan2.1 for a future engine means writing a new adapter that consumes this same schema, with zero changes to any Planner upstream.

motion_strength.description: Already rescaled by the Compiler into the active engine's CapabilityManifest.motion_strength_range.

conditioning_images.description: Asset ids/URIs, for image_to_video or video_edit modes.

engine_id.description: Which engine this RenderSpec was compiled for, set by the Compiler after reading the active CapabilityManifest. Adapters may use this only to select engine-specific serialization - Planners must never branch on it.

quality_tier.description: 'preview' allows a cheap/fast low-step render for storyboard-stage approval before committing to a 'final' full-cost render.
